Licensed & Insured Since Day One

Ryde painters who prove it before they pick up a brush

Plenty of people can hold a roller. Fewer can show you a licence number, current insurance, and two decades of Sydney homes behind them. We can.

Sydney Paintmasters has painted across the City of Ryde for more than 20 years. Every job runs under Painter Decorator Licence 315254C, and we carry full insurance you\u2019re welcome to verify. That matters here. In NSW, residential painting work over $5,000 has to be done by a licensed contractor, so the licence is not a nice-to-have. It\u2019s the law.

Ryde is a mix. A 1960s brick and tile home in West Ryde, a Federation cottage near Denistone, a strata tower stairwell in Macquarie Park, a waterfront exterior in Putney. Each needs a different approach, different products and a different plan. We quote each one on what it actually needs, in writing, at a fixed price. No call-out fee, no surprises on the invoice.

You get the same crew from quote to clean-up. We turn up when we say, protect your place properly, and leave it tidy. Simple, and rarer than it should be.

  • 20+ years of experience — Two decades painting Sydney homes and buildings.
  • Fully licensed & insured — Licence 315254C, insurance you can verify.
  • Fixed-price quotes — Free, written, no call-out fee.
  • Clean and reliable — Same team, on time, tidy at the end of every day.

props.label: Suburbs
props.html:
Across The City Of Ryde

Painters in your part of Ryde

We cover the whole LGA, but every pocket paints a little differently. Here's how we approach each one, and what tends to come up.

Flagship suburb
Eastwood 2122

Painters in Eastwood

Eastwood runs from the busy Rowe Street Mall and Eastwood Plaza out to quiet streets of established homes. Around Lunds Avenue and Summerhayes, parts of the suburb sit inside heritage conservation areas, so colour choices and finishes on those streets need a careful, sympathetic hand rather than whatever’s on special.

We paint shopfronts and offices near the town centre, family homes on the hill, and the older brick and weatherboard places that need proper prep, not a coat over the top. If you’re near a heritage street, we’ll talk you through what suits.

Get an Eastwood quote →
Putney 2112

Painters in Putney

Putney sits on the Parramatta River, with Putney Park and the foreshore drawing the weather straight off the water. Riverfront and near-water homes cop moisture, humidity and salt-tinged air that flat, cheap coatings don’t survive.

We prep for that. Mould treatment, the right primer for the substrate, and durable exterior systems built to hold up to river exposure and strong summer sun. Heritage and character homes near the water get the extra care their timber and render need.

Get a Putney quote →
Denistone 2114

Painters in Denistone

Denistone holds some of Ryde’s most characterful streets. The Chatham Road and Darvall Estate heritage conservation areas cover pockets of the suburb, where Federation and inter-war homes carry period detail worth preserving. On those streets, heritage-approved colours and a light touch on original timber and render make the difference.

Away from the conservation streets, we handle the usual Denistone repaints: eaves, fascias, weatherboard and brick, prepped properly so the finish lasts.

Get a Denistone quote →
Macquarie Park 2113

Painters in Macquarie Park

Macquarie Park is offices, towers and the apartment blocks that have gone up around the Macquarie Centre and the metro. Most of our work here is commercial and strata: lobbies, corridors, stairwells, car parks and occupied-building repaints that have to happen around tenants and trading hours.

We plan the program, put up resident and staff notices, and keep work areas safe and tidy. Your building manager shouldn’t have to chase us. They won’t.

Get a Macquarie Park quote →
Marsfield 2122

Painters in Marsfield

Marsfield sits next to Macquarie University, so there’s a strong rental and investor market alongside the family homes near ELS Hall Park. Rentals need a smart repaint between tenants: hard-wearing, washable low-sheen finishes that survive the next lease, not a rushed coat of flat white.

We prep and patch properly so walls don’t flash through, and we work to your vacancy window where we can.

Get a Marsfield quote →
Meadowbank 2114

Painters in Meadowbank

Meadowbank has changed fast. Around the ferry wharf, the station and the Shepherds Bay apartments, unit blocks and strata schemes now sit alongside older homes near Meadowbank Park. That means plenty of common-area work: stairwells, corridors, balconies and balustrades.

We handle strata programs and individual apartment repaints, working within building access rules, lift bookings and floor protection so the job barely registers with residents.

Get a Meadowbank quote →
Melrose Park 2114

Painters in Melrose Park

Melrose Park, on the Ryde side near Wharf Road and the river, is in the middle of a major redevelopment. New townhouses and apartments are going up alongside established streets, so we see both new-build finishing work and repaints on older homes here.

New builds get a clean, consistent finish to handover standard. Older homes get honest prep first. Either way, one written price, agreed before we start.

Get a Melrose Park quote →
Tennyson Point 2111

Painters in Tennyson Point

Tennyson Point is a small, leafy waterfront peninsula wrapped by Morrisons Bay and Looking Glass Bay, close to the Ryde River Walk and Bill Mitchell Park. The homes here are premium, many with heritage character and serious water exposure.

That calls for careful exterior work: proper preparation, durable UV and moisture-resistant coatings, and a respectful finish on character detail. We treat these homes like the assets they are.

Get a Tennyson Point quote →

The sequence doesn't change, whether it's a single room or a strata block. Preparation is where the finish is won.

Protect & prep

Cover the space, wash surfaces, treat mould, repair and fill, then sand for the substrate.

4

Paint properly

The right system, the honest number of coats, applied clean and even.

5

Check & clean up

We walk it with you, touch up anything, and leave your place tidy.

props.label: Faq
props.html:
Straight Answers

Painter Ryde FAQs

The questions we get asked most, answered plainly. Trust, compliance and warranty first.

Are you licensed and insured to paint in Ryde?
Yes. Sydney Paintmasters holds NSW Painter Decorator Licence 315254C and carries full insurance. You can verify the licence through NSW Fair Trading. In NSW, residential work over $5,000 must be done by a licensed contractor, so this is not optional, and we’re happy for you to check.
Do you charge a call-out fee for quotes?
No. Quotes across the City of Ryde are free, with no call-out fee. We come to the property, look at the actual job, and give you a written fixed price before any work starts.
What warranty do you offer on your painting?
Our work is covered by the statutory warranties that apply to licensed painting in NSW, plus our own workmanship standard. For the exact terms on your job, ask us at quote stage and we will put the guarantee in writing before any work starts.
How much does a painter cost in Ryde?
It depends on condition first, then size, height, access, how much repair is needed and the number of coats. We don’t quote sight unseen, because the prep is the variable. Book a free on-site visit and you’ll get a fixed written price. Call 0423 019 087.
Do you paint strata and apartment common areas?
Yes. We paint stairwells, corridors, lobbies, balconies, balustrades, car parks and facades for strata schemes and unit blocks around Macquarie Park, Meadowbank, Marsfield and the wider Ryde area. We stage the work, notify residents, and paint occupied buildings with minimal disruption.
Can you paint heritage or Federation homes in Denistone and Eastwood?
Yes, and we take extra care with them. Parts of Denistone (Chatham Road, Darvall Estate) and Eastwood (Lunds Avenue, Summerhayes) sit inside heritage conservation areas. We prep original timber, render and masonry carefully and work with heritage-approved colours where the conservation controls apply.
How long does it take to paint a house?
A standard interior can take a few days, a full exterior longer, but it always depends on condition and the extent of repairs. We won’t lock in a date before we’ve seen the surfaces, because promising a timeline blind is how jobs go wrong.
What paint brands and products do you use?
Reputable, professional-grade systems chosen for the surface and its exposure, not for what’s cheapest that week. We match the primer and topcoat to the substrate, whether that’s a river-exposed exterior in Putney or a high-traffic strata stairwell.
Do you paint occupied apartments, offices and shops?
Yes. We work around residents, staff and trading hours, using proper floor protection and staged access. Offices and shops are often painted after hours so your day isn’t disrupted.
What suburbs around Ryde do you cover?
We cover the whole City of Ryde, including Denistone, Eastwood, Macquarie Park, Marsfield, Meadowbank, Melrose Park, Putney, Ryde and Tennyson Point. If your street is nearby and not listed, call 0423 019 087 and we’ll confirm.
Do you give a written fixed-price quote?
Always. You get a clear written scope and a fixed price before we start. For strata jobs we can write the scope so a committee can compare it properly against other tenders, rather than guessing at what’s included.
Can you handle exterior painting near the Parramatta River?
Yes. Waterfront and near-river homes in Putney, Tennyson Point and Melrose Park face moisture, humidity and strong UV. We treat mould, prep thoroughly, and use durable, UV-stable exterior systems built to last in those conditions.
Do you do roof, pool and epoxy floor painting?
We do. Alongside house, interior, exterior, strata and commercial painting, we handle roof recoating, specialist pool coatings, and hard-wearing epoxy floors for garages, warehouses and commercial spaces across Ryde.
What are your operating hours?
We’re open 6am to 6pm Monday to Saturday, and closed Sunday. Call 0423 019 087 during those hours, or send a quote request any time and we’ll reply within 2 business hours.

data.name: Sydney Paintmasters
data.description: Licensed and insured painting business serving Ryde 2112 and the wider City of Ryde for 20+ years. House, interior, exterior, strata, commercial and roof painting, with free fixed-price quotes and no call-out fee.

data.name: Bobby Nojad
data.description: Licensed painter (315254C) leading Sydney Paintmasters across the City of Ryde for 20+ years.

mainEntity.name: Are you licensed and insured to paint in Ryde?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Sydney Paintmasters holds NSW Painter Decorator Licence 315254C and carries full insurance. You can verify the licence through NSW Fair Trading. In NSW, residential work over $5,000 must be done by a licensed contractor, so this is not optional, and we’re happy for you to check.

mainEntity.name: Do you charge a call-out fee for quotes?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Quotes across the City of Ryde are free, with no call-out fee. We come to the property, look at the actual job, and give you a written fixed price before any work starts.

mainEntity.name: What warranty do you offer on your painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our work is covered by the statutory warranties that apply to licensed painting in NSW, plus our own workmanship standard. For the exact terms on your job, ask us at quote stage and we will put the guarantee in writing before any work starts.

mainEntity.name: How much does a painter cost in Ryde?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on condition first, then size, height, access, how much repair is needed and the number of coats. We don’t quote sight unseen, because the prep is the variable. Book a free on-site visit and you’ll get a fixed written price. Call 0423 019 087.

mainEntity.name: Do you paint strata and apartment common areas?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We paint stairwells, corridors, lobbies, balconies, balustrades, car parks and facades for strata schemes and unit blocks around Macquarie Park, Meadowbank, Marsfield and the wider Ryde area. We stage the work, notify residents, and paint occupied buildings with minimal disruption.

mainEntity.name: Can you paint heritage or Federation homes in Denistone and Eastwood?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and we take extra care with them. Parts of Denistone (Chatham Road, Darvall Estate) and Eastwood (Lunds Avenue, Summerhayes) sit inside heritage conservation areas. We prep original timber, render and masonry carefully and work with heritage-approved colours where the conservation controls apply.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to paint a house?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard interior can take a few days, a full exterior longer, but it always depends on condition and the extent of repairs. We won’t lock in a date before we’ve seen the surfaces, because promising a timeline blind is how jobs go wrong.

mainEntity.name: What paint brands and products do you use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Reputable, professional-grade systems chosen for the surface and its exposure, not for what’s cheapest that week. We match the primer and topcoat to the substrate, whether that’s a river-exposed exterior in Putney or a high-traffic strata stairwell.

mainEntity.name: Do you paint occupied apartments, offices and shops?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We work around residents, staff and trading hours, using proper floor protection and staged access. Offices and shops are often painted after hours so your day isn’t disrupted.

mainEntity.name: What suburbs around Ryde do you cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: We cover the whole City of Ryde, including Denistone, Eastwood, Macquarie Park, Marsfield, Meadowbank, Melrose Park, Putney, Ryde and Tennyson Point. If your street is nearby and not listed, call 0423 019 087 and we’ll confirm.

mainEntity.name: Do you give a written fixed-price quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: Always. You get a clear written scope and a fixed price before we start. For strata jobs we can write the scope so a committee can compare it properly against other tenders, rather than guessing at what’s included.

mainEntity.name: Can you handle exterior painting near the Parramatta River?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Waterfront and near-river homes in Putney, Tennyson Point and Melrose Park face moisture, humidity and strong UV. We treat mould, prep thoroughly, and use durable, UV-stable exterior systems built to last in those conditions.

mainEntity.name: Do you do roof, pool and epoxy floor painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: We do. Alongside house, interior, exterior, strata and commercial painting, we handle roof recoating, specialist pool coatings, and hard-wearing epoxy floors for garages, warehouses and commercial spaces across Ryde.
We’re open 6am to 6pm Monday to Saturday, and closed Sunday. Call 0423 019 087 during those hours, or send a quote request any time and we’ll reply within 2 business hours.
